github_surges.description: AI assistant and MCP server for Blender: visual chat, scene tools, multi-agent workflows. Works with ChatGPT/GPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, OpenCode. Blender AI addon, copilot for 3D, bpy Python scripting, MCP integration.
Training Reasoning Models in Simulation to Natively Use Real Robots
Video as code: canvas scenes rendered with WebCodecs in headless Chrome, a review viewer, and agent skills that build the video from your references.

歸藏 Game Skill：让 AI 从零做出能在浏览器里玩的 3D 动作游戏，附可玩演示《雾锁山门》。Agent skill for Claude Code / Codex that builds a playable browser 3D action game with AI-generated assets (three.js, single-HTML). Playable demo included.

Put thousands of live DOM nodes on an infinite canvas: the GPU draws them, an editor selects, moves and resizes them, shaders and transitions run on them, and an AI agent can read them and point at them.
Production-grade AI coding instructions, curated skills, and a 3-stage review pipeline (Planning → Critical Review → Diff Audit) built after 4,500+ hours with AI agents. Agent-agnostic.
An illustrated, hands-on guide to semantic knowledge graphs and property graphs. Learn RDF, OWL, SPARQL, SHACL, Neo4j, Cypher, and graph RAG through one running example.
DIY robot actuator with a custom FOC driver and a cycloidal reducer. CAD, PCB, firmware.

Evidence-grounded multimodal RAG for industrial maintenance documentation, with hybrid retrieval, citations, conflict resolution, claim verification and abstention. Includes an optional tool-using LLM agent and deterministic offline mode.
Hardening ephemeral machine-learning infrastructure: Mitigating zero-day card skimming and runaway hourly compute billing across decentralized cloud GPU providers.
